subject: Segmentation fault on install of rapache mod_R.so

messages.author: e9644a6fba8d352f
messages.subject: Segmentation fault on install of rapache mod_R.so
parts:
I am seeing the following error when I try to load the mod_R.so module in Apache2
./bin/apachectl: line 78: 21440 Segmentation fault: 11  $HTTPD -k $ARGV

OS is OSX 10.8.4
CPU is 2.26GHz Intel Quad-Core Xeon

R installed using macports 2.1.3 (v3.0.1_1+accelerate+cairo+gcc47+recommended+x11)

Configure for rapache
./configure     --with-R=/Volumes/data/bin/R     --with-apache2-apxs=/Volumes/data/apache2/bin/apxs     --with-apreq2-config=/Users/ecenter/Desktop/rapache/libapreq2/apreq2-config

No issues on staring apache2 when adding libapreq2 as the following in the apache2 config file works fine
LoadModule apreq_module /usr/libexec/apache2/mod_apreq2.so
#LoadModule R_module modules/mod_R.so

Anyone have any thoughts?
